author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Mahle (hamstring) to return Wednesday
desc: Tyler Mahle will return from the injured list to start on Wednesday against the Athletics.
impact: Mahle concluded his rehab assignment this week. There should be an official roster move announced by Wednesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Marcelo Mayer (illness) not in lineup Friday
desc: Marcelo Mayer is not in the Red Sox lineup on Friday against the Mariners due to an illness.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andrew Bash signs minor league deal with Athletics
desc: The Athletics signed Andrew Bash to a minor league contract.
impact: Bash was previously in the Twins organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Julio Rodriguez (hamstring) back in lineup Friday
desc: Julio Rodriguez is back in the Mariners lineup on Friday against the Red Sox.
impact: Rodriguez was removed earlier this week due to a spasm in his hamstring. He is back in center field and batting third.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Fernandez (back) begins rehab assignment Friday
desc: Ryan Fernandez began a rehab assignment on Friday.
impact: Fernandez was placed on the injured list back in the first week of June. He'll likely require a handful of rehab appearances before he is activated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Corey Seager (concussion) will not be activated Friday
desc: The Rangers will not activate Corey Seager from the concussion injured list on Friday.
impact: Seager can be activated any day. He could be back this weekend or early next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Miles Mikolas to pitch in bulk relief role Friday
desc: Miles Mikolas will pitch in a bulk relief role on Friday against the Rays.
impact: Mikolas will take the mound behind PJ Poulin, who is opening for Washington.

author: Ari Koslow
title: LaMonte Wade Jr. (hamstring) 'really close' to being activated
desc: The Astros say LaMonte Wade Jr. is "really, really close to being activated."
impact: Wade is working out with the team on Friday. It appears he could be activated from the injured list as early as next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Allen (hamstring) 'really close' to being activated
desc: The Astros say Nick Allen is "really, really close to being activated."
impact: Allen is working out with the team on Friday. It appears he could be activated from the injured list as early as next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cristian Javier (shoulder) to make rehab start Sunday
desc: Cristian Javier will make his next rehab start for Triple-A Sugar Land on Sunday.
impact: If all goes well, Javier will re-join the Astros starting rotation next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gavin Lux (shoulder) to begin rehab assignment June 29
desc: Rays manager Kevin Cash said Gavin Lux will begin a rehab assignment on June 29.
impact: Cash that Lux is feeling better. He should be activated in early July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Edwin Diaz (elbow) throwing bullpen Friday
desc: Edwin Diaz is throwing a bullpen session on Friday.
impact: Diaz has been sidelined since April 20 after undergoing surgery for loose bodies in his right elbow. He continues to progress on his throwing program.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. not going for imaging
desc: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said Vladimir Guerrero Jr. will not go for imaging.
impact: Guerrero Jr. left Friday's game against the Cubs following a swing in the sixth inning. He could be back in the lineup on Saturday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryne Nelson (torn flexor) shut down for several weeks
desc: Ryne Nelson told reporters he will be shut down for several weeks.
impact: Nelson added that his Flexor Tendon is strained but not torn. He will likely be sidelined through the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bradgley Rodriguez optioned to Arizona Complex League
desc: The Padres optioned Bradgley Rodriguez to the Arizona Complex League.
impact: Rodriguez gets optioned with Mason Miller back from the bereavement list. He is expected to get called back up to the majors later in the summer.
